notes: Benchmark ground-state energies (Hartree, non-relativistic, clamped nuclei) for error-vs-reference plots. Sources follow the SPRING paper (arXiv:2401.10190) and PRIME-SR paper (arXiv:2604.18357) conventions. Caveats: N2 values derive from spectroscopic potentials (Le Roy MLR / Filippi-Umrigar), so they carry mHa-level adiabatic/relativistic content relative to the clamped-nuclei Hamiltonian -- fine for optimizer-vs-optimizer comparisons, state the source when quoting absolute errors. H4_square_4.0 has no literature benchmark; the value is this project's own FCI/CBS estimate (see fci_details) -- prefer relative-energy comparisons between optimizers on H4.

C.source: Chakravorty et al., Phys. Rev. A 47, 3649 (1993), Table XI

N.source: Chakravorty et al., Phys. Rev. A 47, 3649 (1993), Table XI

O.source: Chakravorty et al., Phys. Rev. A 47, 3649 (1993), Table XI

LiH_3.015.source: Cencek & Rychlewski; used as the LiH benchmark in the FermiNet paper (Pfau et al. 2020). Bond length 3.015 Bohr; vmcnet's default LiH geometry is 3.0139 Bohr -- sub-mHa geometry offset.

N2_eq_2.016.source: Filippi & Umrigar, J. Chem. Phys. 105, 213 (1996), Table II (via SPRING paper)

N2_4.0.source: Le Roy et al. MLR4(6,8) potential, J. Chem. Phys. 125, 164310 (2006) (via SPRING paper); spectroscopically derived

CO_2.173.source: Pfau et al., Phys. Rev. Research 2, 033429 (2020), Table II (via SPRING paper)

H4_square_4.0.source: This project: FCI/cc-pVTZ, square side 4.0 Bohr, Sz=0 ground state (singlet; the triplet is the first excited state, +11.4 mHa at TZ). PRELIMINARY: aug-cc-pVTZ/CBS refinement pending -- expect the converged value 1-3 mHa lower. Uncertainty ~3 mHa; prefer relative-energy comparisons on H4.

H4_square_4.0.method: PySCF FCI (exact for 4 electrons within the basis), symmetry=False -- symmetry-adapted FCI (symmetry=True) pins the solver to the RHF determinant's irrep and returns a WRONG (excited-state) energy for this system. Sz=0 sector lowest root; broken-symmetry RHF orbitals (level_shift=0.2).
